item.description:
Genre: Electronic, Pop
Style: Dance-pop
Year: 2022
Video Source: Apple Music
Audio Source: Qobuz & Apple Music

"10:35" is a dance-pop/EDM single by Dutch DJ Tiësto featuring Canadian singer Tate McRae. It was released on 3 November 2022 through Musical Freedom and Atlantic Records as the sixth single from Tiësto's seventh studio album Drive. The song is also featured in the soundtrack of F1 23.

The music video for the song was filmed at Atlantis The Royal beach hotel resort at the Palm Jumeirah, Dubai. The song was inspired by the opening and the "dual experience" of the resort, which opened in January 2023. Lyrically, it explores the transition from day to night, capturing a sense of freedom and romance at 10:35 PM. In the official music video, the line “just pass the bottle” is replaced with “no time for sorrow” (only on the original track of this release).

"Tate and I wanted to create a song that captured the energy of an experience at Atlantis The Royal, and I'm proud to say the feeling of 10:35 and this property are both infectious! So excited for the world to finally hear it."

— Tiësto on the song celebrating the partnership with the resort, Billboard
